reason: Although config/initializers/i18n.rb:5 and config/initializers/i18n.rb:9 call send(:include, ...) on I18n::Backend::Simple and I18n.backend.class, including I18n::Backend::Pluralization and I18n::Backend::Fallbacks into the backend class is the i18n gem's documented public extension API (and the same mechanism Rails's config.i18n.fallbacks uses). Using send(:include, ...) simply accounts for Ruby's Module#include being private prior to Ruby 2.1 rather than fragile monkey-patching of gem internals.
